build_population_game: build a population game with senders and receivers using specified communication channel options
build_senders_receivers: build sender and receiver agents from vision module names and communication channel config
build_second_game: build a second game for retraining by loading a checkpoint and adding new agents
compute_loss: compute cross-entropy loss and accuracy for receiver output against ground truth labels
find_module_from_name: find a vision module tuple from a list by matching its name attribute
